content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing required prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another unsupported appeal would not cure the authorization defect; the patient cannot properly be billed for this provider-side denial beyond an adjudicated contractual share. With no remaining payer or secondary path and no collectible patient liability established, the balance should be written off.","action":"write_off"}
